author: Tikai
body:
Hi,

So today I got banned for "Refusing to screen share", which is complete bullshit. 
Hope you realise that I was on my dads computer, which I never use except today since he was out and my laptop is broken. That's why I've been inactive, this past week, my teammates can verify.

There are many reasons (Oh so many) but here are the most important and relevant:

1) Not my computer, so why would I hack on it? Or why would I bother to screen share on a computer that isn't mine?

2) My parents (Yes I have parents) would get mad if I did something like screen sharing on this computer which holds my dads work stuff which basically feeds us, gives me an education and gives me a home. I'm not letting some COMPLETE STRANGERS take a look...I hope you understand.

3) My mum was shouting at me to come down for dinner because it was 6:40-50 and I didn't expect to play this long or let alone be accused of hacking and perm banned.. I'd already been playing for 4 and a half hours straight.

Show your so called "Proof",also my ping is usually below 10ms which people know.

Thanks for your Consideration,
iTimeless

replies.body: You refused to screenshare, that is against the rules. Your parents would never find out that you screenshared, and you say you wouldn't hack on your parent's computer, but what difference would it make for you to hack considering you're playing the game.

replies.author: Tikai
replies.body:
Look, I don't know what this 'Screenshare' bullshit is, nor do I care to risk finding out about it. 

You seem to not get what my main point is, I don't want to let complete strangers look over my dads computer, he works for an IT company and do you really think he wouldn't find out? I had to ask him today and he checks my history after and asks what I was doing. Maybe you think I'm over exaggerating, but I'm not. He just really worries about what the Internet can do. (Eg. Viruses, HACKING)

I remember 'Xuph' got unbanned from scamming. He got unbanned in just a month and a bit, I got banned because you guys THINK, that I hack. Hence why you ask me to screenshare, and yet I can only appeal in six months...A bit bias are we?

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
If it was down to me, Xuph would still be banned, and he would be for another 4 months. Xuph is unbanned because he never broke a rule technically. 

You broke a rule. We're not looking over whatever your dad does, we literally look at your .minecraft and a few other files - nothing private. If I ever looked at anything private, I would instantly get demoted, and possibly banned.

You say this as if the internet is a terrible place, which don't get me wrong, it can be, however isn't. If you're so scared, you really shouldn't be on the internet. If you're not stupid, there is no risk of you being on the internet, and there is no risk in screensharing.

replies.body:
Sorry for the late reply, I was busy. Though I am shocked by your very loose definition of proof. 

Apollo, Eternal Cross, China Baby Toes, all these teams, are insanely good at pvp and 1v1's, most of them are better than me. Yet, it seems like you think i'm the one hacking? 

The fact that Tazz, the person that we were against banned me, kind of annoys me. 

Furthermore, that 'proof' is bullshit. I saw nothing there, you can record Tazz fighting and you will see the same outcome, weird flicks happen to everyone, even the worst of players.

You guys are so caught up in thinking i'm hacking that you seem to forget that there were ACTUAL hackers. I think CBT definitely have hackers, and lets not start with eternal cross..

But as soon as we mention that to you referees, you just pin it on 'good ping' or 'good kb cause of where he lives'.

But me? No, you just go picking on me for this sad excuse of proof, and all for what, because my head twitched a couple of times? Because tazz was sad someone actually can beat him?

This proof just proves that I have good ping, so thank you for showing that I have good ping, banning me for 6 months because I refused to screenshare is absured.
